title: Random projection with linear equalities and inequalities
summary: Random projection is a preprocessing technique for optimization that reduces the number of linear equality constraints by replacing them with random linear combinations while approximately preserving the optimal value. In this paper, we emphasize the role of suprema of random processes, and in particular generic chaining, in explaining this phenomenon. By combining Lagrangian duality with generic chaining, we obtain shorter proofs and sharper guarantees that apply beyond the typical polyhedral settings based on the Johnson--Lindenstrauss lemma.
